sentences.t: The biggest IPO opens: Jio Platforms opens for subscription today (closes Friday), ₹1,065 to ₹1,119 a share, lot of 12.
Anchors put in ₹8,110 crore on Monday against bids of nearly ₹2.5 lakh crore; LIC, BlackRock, GIC and Norges Bank are in.
Insurance economics reset: IRDAI's distribution paper caps first-year life commissions at 20-25%, halves insurer expense limits over five years, and defines mis-selling with clawbacks.
Industry veterans warn 15-40% of agents could exit over two to four years.
Yes Bank's ₹8,415 crore bill: the Supreme Court has upheld the quashing of the 2020 AT1 bond write-off.
The bank must honour the bonds at 9-9.5% coupons plus interest; pro forma CET1 falls to about 11.4%.
Management says no immediate capital raise.
While India was shut: Wall Street rose Tuesday (Dow +1.02%), oil eased after touching $112, French stocks fell on unrest, and Nasdaq futures are up 200 points this morning on an AI-results rebound.
Zerodha goes global: US stock investing is live in beta on Kite - 2,000 stocks and 1,000 ETFs, fractional from $1, 0.1% brokerage capped at $10.
Today to watch: Jio day-1 subscription numbers through the session; RBI publishes the minutes of its 7 October rate-hike meeting today; Zetwerk lists Friday.
Bajaj Finance: FY27 AUM growth guidance raised to 26-27% after a 28.5% profit jump; management flags margin pressure from rate hikes.
Hindustan Zinc: Q2 profit up 17.2% to ₹6,412 crore, beating estimates.
Genus Power: board meets 26 October to consider a buyback.
